paper.title: Exploring Two-Phase Continual Instruction Fine-tuning for Multilingual Adaptation in Large Language Models
paper.formula_caveat: Paper X is layer x feature after sample averaging, giving one feature covariance across layers; no unique per-layer curve follows from this formula alone. Do not invent its curve implementation.

input_manifest.split: 128/source-task-language per half for MC; 64 math per half; documents/subjects/normalized numeric-skeleton groups disjoint
input_manifest.all_materials_exposed: Existing benchmark pools; development mechanism diagnostic, not untouched final confirmation
input_manifest.exact_near_duplicate_limit: Source grouping and normalized numeric skeletons; no claim of exhaustive semantic deduplication

prompt_protocol.MCF: full-sequence BF16 logits, four single-token space-prefixed labels, assistant prefill Answer:
prompt_protocol.benchmark_caveat: Diagnostic prompts differ from formal Belebele 3-shot/MMLU 5-shot/GSM8K 5-shot. State transitions refer to THIS frozen protocol; never merge into formal benchmark table.

extraction.boundary: raw residual stream immediately after each decoder block, before final model norm
extraction.primary: decision_position = last effective input token, including assistant prefill
sensitivities: mean over content_indices; exclude chat/instruction template
extraction.storage: Only 3 pooled vectors per layer per sample; no full-token caches
extraction.tensor_shape: N=1152 x L=28 x P=3 x D=1536, float32 on CPU

metrics.layer_covariance: For each fixed task/language/phase set, X is N x D; C=(X-mean(X)).T@(X-mean(X))/(N-1); report ||C_adapt-C_base||F/max(||C_base||F,1e-12), float64, via exact sample Gram identities
metrics.paper_style: Average representations over fixed samples to get L x D; center across L and compute covariance with denominator L-1; report separate global scalar, not a guessed layerwise reproduction

analysis.primary: EN Base-correct: forgotten vs retained, mean decision-position cosine drift across all 28 blocks
controls: Base gold-label probability and margin for MC
analysis.math_analysis: Separate task; no token likelihood treated as probability of full reasoning correctness. Exclude unparsed outputs from F/R, report counts and strict-format rate separately.
analysis.model: logistic regression C=1, standardize on discovery only; fixed group-disjoint confirmation; no regularization scan
analysis.parameter_norm_limit: Global update norms are constant within each model, only 3 adapted models; descriptive cross-model comparison, no independent-sample regression claim
analysis.unit: source group; same sampled groups for paired comparisons
analysis.multiplicity: Primary mean-all-layer analysis predeclared; all 28 layer curves reported, layerwise p-values exploratory with BH-FDR
analysis.directional: Residual change projected onto fixed Base correct-vs-highest-incorrect unembedding contrast; exploratory, only MC, layer coordinate caveat

patching_gate.contradiction_rule: No other adequately powered model has delta AUROC CI wholly below zero
patching_gate.inadequate_samples: Evidence insufficient; no data expansion or automatic patching

patching_if_gate_passes.models: Only models passing individual gate; no supplemental models
conditions: Base activation at fixed noncandidate block0
seed42 random direction with per-example matched L2 displacement at block13
patching_if_gate_passes.inputs: All fixed confirmation MC samples, both EN and SW; masks/tokens identical; use_cache=False
patching_if_gate_passes.report: English recovered/newly lost, SW acquired lost, paired source intervals; no claim of unique knowledge storage

tsne.subset: first32 hash-ranked confirmation examples per task/language among MC, same IDs across four models
tsne.standardization: joint feature mean/std, then joint PCA50
tsne.role: auxiliary only; report instability, never choose best seed or layer
